rows.evidence: Q1: Methods/Results, Table 3 - authors train KNN, SVM and ANN on a web-sourced irrigation dataset (wheat, maize, potato) and report their own accuracy figures (ANN 96.81%); Section 3 also reports building an Arduino/Raspberry Pi IoT system and testing it in a potato and a wheat field.
rows.notes: The study's own result is classification accuracy of the irrigate/not-irrigate decision on a scraped dataset originally from an Indian institute, plus a one-sentence qualitative statement that in two field tests the pump opened only when irrigation was needed. No water applied, water saved or wastage is measured or reported, so there is no own evidence on the claimed effect (reduction of water wastage); the study only shows the precondition that the system can automatically decide when to irrigate. Water-loss reduction is asserted in the title/abstract but not demonstrated.

notes: Full text appears complete. The paper is a short algorithm-comparison study; the field deployment is described in one sentence without data, duration, site description or any water-use measurement.
